versions.changelog:
Initial release of Open Platform Asset Builder for WorkBuddy.

- Generates asset bundles for WorkBuddy platform: skills, connectors, experts, expert teams, and Buddy apps, following official specification.
- Provides field-level spec validation, packaging, and submission guidance with built-in scripts and templates.
- Organized with a strict two-level directory structure; includes references, scripts, and templates for each asset type.
- Supports read/write, script execution, and different permission modes (standard, read-only, no-write).
- Includes modular, catalog-based generation pipeline and extensive sample/model files for all asset types.
